name: @mcv/vision
description: Agent eyes+hands on a real browser. CDP-driven accessibility-tree snapshots + ref-id-addressed actions (click/type/scroll/wait/navigate). Pure SDK: takes a CDPSession in, returns JSON/Uint8Array out. Consumed by mcv-one-desktop/server/vision-broker (daemon+HITL+SQLite) and by the Antigravity MCP adapter. Broker persistence, approval gating, and UI live in the Desktop cockpit — not in this package.
